_about: PPS outbound click-to-call, triggered from a Missive comment. Type `/call <number>` in any Missive conversation; Twilio rings your cell (602 541 7395), you answer, and it bridges you to <number> showing 602 560 3743 as caller ID. Reuses the same Missive-comment webhook pattern as the ChatGPT-comment scenario.
_import: Make → Create a scenario → ⋯ menu → Import Blueprint → upload this file. On import, pick/create the Missive 'new comment' webhook for module 1 (a hook was already created: id 2773327, url https://hook.us1.make.com/r69ten0j057faektkrxsb1uu21g0yf4k), and confirm the Twilio (350124) + Missive (1151021) connections.
name: PPS: Missive → Click-to-Call (outbound)

notification.title: 📞 Click-to-call
notification.body: Your phone is ringing to connect the call.

mapper.markdown: 📞 **Calling {{"+1" + right(replace(1.comment.body; "/[^0-9]/g"; ""); 10)}}** — your phone (602 541 7395) is ringing; answer to connect. Caller ID shows 602 560 3743.

_notes.number_parsing: Takes the last 10 digits typed in the comment and prepends +1 (handles dashes/parens/spaces and a leading 1). Type the number alone after /call, e.g. `/call 602-555-1234`; extra digits elsewhere in the comment could confuse it.
_notes.ring_target: to = +16025417395 (your cell). Change here to ring a different phone.
_notes.caller_id: Both legs use +16025603743, so the person you call sees the PPS business number.
